keyEvents.text: Carlos Moreno (Pachuca) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Hugo González (Toluca).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Sergio Barreto (Pachuca).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Sergio Barreto (Pachuca).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Pachuca 0, Toluca 0.
Goal! Pachuca 1, Toluca 0. Alán Bautista (Pachuca) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Salomón Rondón.
Rodolfo Pizarro (Pachuca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Alexis Vega (Toluca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Rodolfo Pizarro (Pachuca).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Toluca. Jesús Angulo replaces Federico Viñas.
Substitution, Toluca. Jorge Díaz replaces Víctor Guzmán.
Substitution, Toluca. Santiago Simón replaces Alexis Vega.
Substitution, Pachuca. Sebastián Santos replaces Alán Bautista.
Substitution, Pachuca. Kenedy replaces Nicolás Vallejo.
Substitution, Toluca. Pável Pérez replaces Nicolás Castro.
Substitution, Toluca. Axel Cervantes replaces Brian García.
Substitution, Pachuca. Mauricio Isaís replaces Francisco Venegas.
Jorge Berlanga (Pachuca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jesús Gallardo (Toluca) Yellow Card at 88'
Hugo González (Toluca) is shown the red card.
Goal! Pachuca 2, Toluca 0. Salomón Rondón (Pachuca) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Pachuca. Cristóbal Hernández replaces Rodolfo Pizarro.
Substitution, Pachuca. Pedro Budib replaces Oussama Idrissi.
